attempts.query: Giant Defy Advanced 2 ride stiffness review
attempts.note: Manufacturer attributes steering stiffness to OverDrive and vibration absorption to D-Fuse; no numeric test is published.

attempts.query: Giant Defy Advanced 2 TOUR test comfort
attempts.note: Review reports smooth rough-road comfort and an upright, relatively heavy feel; it is not a measured current-mainland stiffness result.

notes: Manufacturer claims and older independent ride impressions remain separately labeled.
